hypothesis: A zero-fitted-parameter VWAP-to-mid deviation short-term reversion signal -- a 20-bar (20-minute) rolling volume-weighted average price (VWAP) on BTC-USDT native 1-minute bars, with a Bollinger-Band-shaped envelope around it (upper/lower = VWAP +/- 2 * sample-stdev(closes) over the same 20-bar window), entering LONG when close crosses below the lower band (oversold) and SHORT when close crosses above the upper band (overbought), sized to a constant 20% annualized volatility target, with no ADX regime gate, no ATR stop/target, no risk:reward grid and no funding signal driving direction or size, executed exclusively via GUARDED_MARKET orders -- exhibits a real, non-zero, positive risk-adjusted return (a Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio >= 0.95 against a zero benchmark, on daily-resampled returns) over the ENTIRE real BingX BTC-USDT 1-minute retention window (2024-11-30T16:00:00Z through 2026-08-24T15:27:00Z exclusive, 910,040 bars, configs/research/holdout_1m.json's whole-window holdout per Scalping Strategy Research Task S3's design decision) -- a window no trial in this project's history has ever accessed before this registration. Both the 20-period lookback and the 2-standard-deviation threshold are external, practitioner/technical-analysis conventions (the SAME values research/strategies/mean_reversion.py's own DEFAULT_BOLLINGER_PERIOD/DEFAULT_BOLLINGER_K already use for a differently-centered indicator, reused here rather than re-derived; independently corroborated by real 2026-08-25 web research on VWAP-band reversion trading), NOT peer-reviewed academic parameters -- stated plainly rather than overclaimed. The underlying reversion MECHANISM this hypothesis tests is supported by arXiv:2602.00776 ('Explainable Patterns in Cryptocurrency Microstructure'), which found VWAP-to-mid deviations show 'asymmetric effects coherent with short-lived pressure and microstructure reversion' -- but that paper analyzed Binance Futures order-book/trade data at 1-SECOND frequency, not this project's own 1-MINUTE-OHLCV proxy implementation on BingX. This registration tests that proxy as a real hypothesis, not an imported result -- CLAUDE.md's own Scalping Strategy Research section already discloses this gap explicitly.
prior_art: arXiv:2602.00776, 'Explainable Patterns in Cryptocurrency Microstructure' -- real support for VWAP-to-mid deviation reversion as a genuine microstructure effect, at 1-second Binance Futures order-book/trade frequency (not this project's own 1-minute OHLCV proxy, which remains an untested hypothesis this registration is the first real test of).

research/strategies/mean_reversion.py's own DEFAULT_BOLLINGER_PERIOD=20 / DEFAULT_BOLLINGER_K=Decimal('2') -- the same external, not-fit-to-this-project convention reused here for the VWAP band's period/width, rather than re-derived from scratch.

Real 2026-08-25 web research on VWAP mean-reversion trading conventions (general market-commentary/practitioner sources, explicitly NOT peer-reviewed academic literature -- disclosed as such): 2 standard deviations as the most commonly cited VWAP-reversion entry threshold across multiple independent sources (e.g. a cited '63% reversion rate from 2-standard-deviation extensions'); 20 (or 50) periods on a 1-minute chart as a common practitioner scalping-anchor convention; and a consistent, real warning across sources that mean-reversion strategies fail in strongly trending markets without a regime filter -- directly informing this strategy's own disclosed, deliberately-unmitigated unbounded-holding-period risk (see research/strategies/vwap_mid_reversion.py's own module docstring).

declared_power.derivation: One-sided, alpha=0.05: power = Phi(sqrt(years)*SR_true - Phi^-1(1-alpha)), the same normal-approximation method research/run_preregistered_holdout.py::recompute_detection_floor_sharpe and every prior holdout registration (sr-u, sr-aa) use. years = 910040 bars / 1440 bars-per-day / 365 = 1.7314307458143072. Phi^-1(0.95) = 1.6448536 (statistics.NormalDist().inv_cdf(0.95)). At assumed_true_sharpe=1.0 (the registered value): power = Phi(sqrt(1.7314307458143072)*1.0 - 1.6448536) = Phi(1.31584 - 1.64485) = Phi(-0.32901) = 0.3711 -- a real edge of Sharpe 1.0 would be MISSED by this single holdout access more often than not, disclosed plainly rather than glossed over. At assumed_true_sharpe=2.0 (reported for completeness per this registration's own precedent, sr-u/sr-aa -- not the registered scalar value, the schema's declared_power object carries exactly one point): power = Phi(sqrt(1.7314307458143072)*2.0 - 1.6448536) = Phi(2.63168 - 1.64485) = Phi(0.98683) = 0.8381. All four numbers (years, both Phi arguments, both probabilities) were computed directly via Python (statistics.NormalDist, math.sqrt) against the real expected_bars/bars_per_day above, not hand-derived -- see .planning/scalp-s4-vwap-mid-reversion.md for the exact commands run.

outcome_interpretation.PASS: PSR >= 0.95 on daily-resampled holdout returns against a zero benchmark, with max drawdown <= 20%, total trades >= 31 and profit factor >= 1.3 all cleared, AND the observed annualized Sharpe exceeding this window's own 1.250042 detection floor (CLAUDE.md's holdout single-window variant, clause 3). A genuine first-candidate result for the Scalping Strategy Research direction, subject to the rest of CLAUDE.md's Backtest/Walk-Forward Eligibility Bar and its separate Paper Trading Pass Criteria / Live Entry Criteria, exactly as sr-u's own registration stated for its own PASS region -- this outcome is not itself an automatic promotion.
outcome_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: PSR is POSITIVE (> 0) but at least one of the five primary_criterion checks fails to clear: PSR < 0.95, OR max drawdown > 0.20, OR total trades < 31 (reported INCONCLUSIVE-DATA-LIMITED -- neither a pass nor a fail, and not evidence against the strategy), OR profit factor < 1.3, OR the observed Sharpe fails to exceed the window's own 1.250042 detection floor (reported 'not powered to confirm' per clause 3). Matches evaluate_gating's own real precedence exactly (research/run_preregistered_holdout.py, verified directly before writing this sentence): `if all five checks pass: PASS`, `elif PSR is None or PSR <= 0: FAIL`, `else: INCONCLUSIVE`. META-CONSEQUENCE, MODELED ON sr-ab's REASONING RATHER THAN sr-u/sr-v's -- explained explicitly here rather than silently copied from the wrong precedent: sr-u's own INCONCLUSIVE text said its outcome 'ends the BTC-only price-signal research program... the next move is a named structural change,' because that WAS the terminal event for an eight-family, 117-trial research line. This registration is different in kind: it is the FIRST candidate in a still-young, multi-candidate Scalping Strategy Research direction (CLAUDE.md's own Task S4 explicitly names order-flow-imbalance and other candidates as untested alternatives). An INCONCLUSIVE result here therefore parks THIS SPECIFIC zero-fitted-parameter hypothesis -- VWAP-to-mid reversion at 20-period/2-SD on 1-minute BTC-USDT -- as a candidate. It does NOT by itself end the broader scalping research direction, and it does NOT retroactively validate or invalidate any other strategy family's own results, which stand unaffected on their own terms. The only remaining legitimate remedy for THIS specific hypothesis is a structurally different parameterization or signal mechanism (not a re-run of this exact spec, and not a grid search over period/k, which this registration's own zero-fitted-parameter design and stopping_rule below both foreclose).
outcome_interpretation.FAIL: PSR at or below 0 (a non-positive point estimate, or the statistic is undefined for a degenerate zero-trade result) -- TAKES PRECEDENCE over INCONCLUSIVE above regardless of the other four checks, matching evaluate_gating's own real precedence. The hypothesis is dead as specified. Same reconsidered, sr-ab-style meta-consequence as the INCONCLUSIVE region above: this parks THIS SPECIFIC hypothesis, and does not by itself end the broader scalping research direction or speak to any other candidate's prospects.

stopping_rule: Exactly one execution of this registration against configs/research/holdout_1m.json's whole-window holdout, via research.holdout.load_holdout_klines's single-access-per-strategy_id claim mechanism. This is the FIRST holdout access ever attempted for strategy_id='vwap-mid-reversion' and the first ever for the 'btc-scalping' strategy_family. No candidate may be added, removed or re-valued after this file is committed: a changed grid (a different vwap_period or deviation_k) is a NEW registration with a new preregistration_id, visible in git log and in the preregistration_sha256 recorded on the affected run -- this registration's own zero-fitted-parameter design means there is no legitimate reason to ever need one, since the whole point of choosing external, not-fit-to-this-project constants is that there is nothing left to tune. A real re-run under a force_reclaim_reason is possible under research.holdout's own existing (deliberately permissive, see github.com/ckrhehfl/trading-engine/issues/58) mechanism, but is not anticipated or pre-justified here the way sr-aa's registration pre-justified its own second access -- an unplanned reclaim of THIS strategy_id would need its own real justification at the time, not one invented in advance.
